task: Create pelican.html: a web page with an inline SVG drawing of a pelican riding a bicycle. Make the drawing recognizable: bicycle wheels, frame, and the pelican with its big beak.

args.content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Pelican on a Bicycle</title>
</head>
<body style="margin: 0; padding: 20px; background-color: #f0f8ff; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; min-height: 100vh;">
    <svg width="400" height="300" viewBox="0 0 400 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
        <!-- Background -->
        <rect width="400" height="300" fill="#e6f7ff"/>
        
        <!-- Ground -->
        <path d="M 0 280 L 400 280 L 400 300 L 0 300 Z" fill="#90ee90"/>
        
        <!-- Bicycle Frame -->
        <path d="M 150 250 L 250 250 L 280 180 L 220 180 L 200 120 L 140 120 Z" fill="#cd7f32" stroke="#8b4513" stroke-width="2"/>
        <path d="M 150 250 L 140 120" fill="none" stroke="#cd7f32" stroke-width="2"/>
        <path d="M 280 180 L 220 180" fill="none" stroke="#cd7f32" stroke-width="2"/>
        
        <!-- Front Wheel -->
        <circle cx="140" cy="120" r="35" fill="#f5deb3" stroke="#8b4513" stroke-width="2"/>
        <circle cx="140" cy="120" r="28" fill="#c0c0c0" stroke="#696969" stroke-width="1"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="85" x2="140" y2="155" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2"/>
        <line x1="115" y1="120" x2="165" y2="120" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2"/>
        
        <!-- Rear Wheel -->
        <circle cx="280" cy="180" r="35" fill="#f5deb3" stroke="#8b4513" stroke-width="2"/>
        <circle cx="280" cy="180" r="28" fill="#c0c0c0" stroke="#696969" stroke-width="1"/>
        <line x1="280" y1="145" x2="280" y2="215" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2"/>
        <line x1="245" y1="180" x2="315" y2="180" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2"/>
        
        <!-- Handlebars -->
        <path d="M 140 120 L 130 100 L 160 95" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2"/>
        
        <!-- Seat Post and Seat -->
        <line x1="220" y1="180" x2="220" y2="140" stroke="#cd7f32" stroke-width="3"/>
        <ellipse cx="220" cy="140" rx="15" ry="8" fill="#654321"/>
        
        <!-- Pelican Body -->
        <ellipse cx="200" cy="170" rx="40" ry="30" fill="#ffcc99" stroke="#d2b48c" stroke-width="1"/>
        
        <!-- Pelican Head -->
        <circle cx="165" cy="130" r="25" fill="#ffcc99" stroke="#d2b48c" stroke-width="1"/>
        
        <!-- Pelican Eye -->
        <circle cx="170" cy="125" r="3" fill="#000"/>
        
        <!-- Pelican Beak (Large and distinctive) -->
        <path d="M 165 130 L 220 145 L 210 180 L 170 165 Z" fill="#ff9999" stroke="#d2b48c" stroke-width="1"/>
        <path d="M 165 130 Q 220 145 210 180" fill="none" stroke="#d2b48c" stroke-width="1"/>
        
        <!-- Pelican Wing -->
        <path d="M 190 170 L 230 160 L 225 185 L 185 190 Z" fill="#ffcc99" stroke="#d2b48c" stroke-width="1"/>
        
        <!-- Pelican Legs -->
        <path d="M 180 170 L 165 230" fill="none" stroke="#cd7f32" stroke-width="4"/>
        <path d="M 220 170 L 235 230" fill="none" stroke="#cd7f32" stroke-width="4"/>
        
        <!-- Bicycle Pedals -->
        <circle cx="200" cy="180" r="5" fill="#696969"/>
        <circle cx="240" cy="180" r="5" fill="#696969"/>
        
        <!-- Bicycle Chain -->
        <path d="M 200 180 L 240 180" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="2,2"/>
    </svg>
</body>
</html>

args.message:
Created pelican.html with an inline SVG drawing of a pelican riding a bicycle. The drawing includes:
- Bicycle: two wheels with spokes, frame, handlebars, seat, pedals, and chain
- Pelican: head with eye, large distinctive beak, body, wing, and legs
The file is ready to be opened in any web browser.
